items.label: Efficient Performance for Everyday Tasks
items.value: Powered by the Intel Processor and Intel Graphics, this 14-inch laptop delivers smooth performance for browsing, online classes, office tasks, and streaming. Windows 11 Home 64-bit provides a modern, intuitive interface to enhance productivity, huge amounts of storage mean you can save your entire multimedia library on your PC without compromise.

items.label: Key Features
items.value: Enjoy faster, more reliable wireless performance with Wi-Fi 6 (2x2) and Bluetooth 5.4. Includes all the essential ports you need: USB-C, 2× USB-A, HDMI 1.4b, SD media card reader, headphone/microphone combo jack, and AC Smart Pin.A soft Rose Gold finish adds a modern and elegant look to your workspace, making it ideal for students, young professionals, and anyone who prefers a clean and aesthetic setup.

items.label: Portable 14" HD Display with Anti-Glare Comfort
items.value: Features a 14-inch HD (1366×768) LED micro-edge display with 250 nits brightness and anti-glare technology, offering clear and comfortable viewing indoors or on the go. 62.5% sRGB coverage and a 79% screen-to-body ratio provide an immersive visual experience.

items.label: Enhanced Video Calls & Smart Input Features
items.value: Stay clear and confident in virtual meetings with the HP True Vision 720p HD camera featuring temporal noise reduction and dual array microphones. Includes a full-size keyboard with a dedicated Microsoft Copilot key and a multi-touch HP Imagepad for effortless navigation.

items.label: Lightweight Design with All-Day Battery Life
items.value: Designed for mobility with a sleek Natural Silver chassis weighing just 3.24 lbs. Enjoy up to 11 hours of video playback or 7.5 hours of wireless streaming, making it ideal for school, travel, and everyday use.

items.label: Other Special Features of the Product
items.value: Anti Glare Coating, HD Audio, Memory Card Slot, Spill Resistant

items.label: Compatible Devices
items.value: External displays, mice, keyboards, storage devices, headphones, speakers, printers, and other accessories that use USB, HDMI, or Bluetooth connections
